title: ABB中国总裁韩辉：上海超级工厂全球最先进，柔性模块化生产提升产能300%
speaker: Henry Han

segments.en: you mentioned to me earlier that you have three global mega factories but the Shanghai one is actually the most advanced tell me what is advanced about the Shanghai factory and what lessons you're learning from Shanghai that you're applying to the rest of the world
segments.zh: 你之前提到有三个全球超级工厂，但上海工厂最先进。请介绍其先进性以及从上海学到的经验如何应用到全球

segments.en: yes we have three major manufacturing bases in Sweden in US and China China plan we're putting to production by the December 2022 is the biggest and most advanced so far
segments.zh: 我们在瑞典、美国和中国有三大制造基地，中国工厂于2022年12月投产，是迄今最大、最先进的

segments.en: so this factory actually instead of using the traditional assembly line we have a flexible modular work cell then digitally connected and network that's served by autonomous mobile robots bringing the parts assembly around the cells
segments.zh: 该工厂采用柔性模块化工作单元，数字互联，由自主移动机器人运送零部件到各单元

segments.en: so that cut our off-road space by 50 percent well boost production capacity by 300 percent so that's is really unparalleled in the industry now we're building up like speed expansion
segments.zh: 这减少了50%的占地面积，产能提升300%，在行业内无与伦比。我们正在加速扩张

segments.en: all that learnings in China we actually bring back to Sweden where the the ABB robots was born so I understand that there is a deal going on the ABB robotics potentially going to be sold to soft bank
segments.zh: 我们将中国的经验带回ABB机器人的诞生地瑞典。我了解到ABB机器人业务可能出售给软银
